A 3-digit number abc has first digit a, second digit b and third digit c.
In this part a 2 c.
So the number 601 has a = 6, b = 0 and c = 1.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
There is a relationship between a - c and the reverse difference.
Investigate this relationship, giving three examples.
Write down this relationship.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Anna says that a is the hundreds digit, b is the tens digit and c is the units digit.
She says the value of abc is 100a + 10b + c.
Anna writes the value of the reverse number cba. 100c + 10b + a
She writes the difference between the two numbers. (100a + 10b + c) - (100c + 10b + a)
Continue Anna’s working to show that the
reverse difference is 99(a - c).
